name: Calls Gitaly
description: A component makes Git RPC calls to a Gitaly node (webservice, Sidekiq and GitLab Shell all do). The TLS property matters for FIPS: the communication between components must be compliant too.

storage_names.description: The repository storages the caller reaches on this node.

tls.description: Whether the connection uses TLS (port 9999) rather than plaintext (8075).
